svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.16.2.2 Support of Floors
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.16 FLOORS-ON-GROUND
Support of Floors

g.text: No material that changes volume with moisture or
Not frost-susceptible where the floor will
Clean coarse aggregate, not more than 10%
passing a 4 mm sieve: compaction not required

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Material susceptible to changes in volume due
to variations in moisture content or
chemical-microbiological oxidation is not used
as fill beneath floors-on-ground in a
concentration that will damage the building
To a degree that would adversely affect its
stability or the performance of assemblies. See
also Article 9.4.4.4. and Note A-9.4.4.4.(1).
Material susceptible to changes in volume due
to freezing is not used as fill beneath
floors-on-ground that will be subjected to
freezing temperatures
Except as in Sentence (4), fill beneath
floors-on-ground is compacted
Fill need not be compacted where it is clean
coarse aggregate containing not more than 10%
of material that will pass a 4 mm sieve
Drawn: fill under a slab, cut through. B: an unheated space, frost marks. C: a plate compactor on the fill. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.16.2.2. (page 9-129)
